name: Made In Show
description:
Made In Show (MIS) is the management platform for event production companies — audio, video and lighting service providers. This connector links Claude to your company's MIS installation so your team can work with live production data in plain language.

Ask about productions and their schedules, check warehouse availability for specific dates, spot material and crew conflicts before they happen, read production notes and supplier statistics — and, when your administrator allows it, act on the data: reserve equipment, add locations, create productions, and draft estimate texts.

Access is off by default and controlled per user by your MIS administrator: each user's AI access can view data, view and act, or nothing at all. Write operations follow the same per-user permission, enforced server-side on every call; tools designed for impactful changes (such as creating a production) add their own two-step confirmation. The connector authenticates with OAuth against your installation; data flows only between Claude and your MIS backend, is never used for model training by Made In Show, and tool calls are logged for 90 days for audit purposes (responses are never stored).

Requires an account on a Made In Show installation with AI access enabled by the administrator.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Made In Show to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Made In Show to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude.madeinshow.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Made In Show MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Made In Show lists 30 MCP tools, including mis_add_contact, mis_add_location, mis_add_technician_unavailability, mis_batch_reserve_products, mis_check_material_conflicts, mis_check_product_availability, mis_check_technician_conflicts, mis_create_production, mis_del_technician_unavailability, mis_get_company_summary, mis_get_contact_sheet, and mis_get_estimate.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Made In Show?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Made In Show in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Made In Show MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Made In Show requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Made In Show is developed by SyncLab Studio. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
